001: Good morning, I need to register my address in this municipality.
Good morning, of course. Do you have an appointment?
No, I don't. Is it essential?
Yes, it is. But you can book one now for tomorrow morning.
Okay, then I'll book the appointment for tomorrow. Thank you very much.
You're welcome. Don't forget to bring the rental contract and your ID.
002: I wanted to request the certificate of residence registration.
Very well, may I have your identity document, please?
Here you go. How long does it take to be issued?
We give it to you right away, at no cost.
Perfect, then I'll take it with me now. Thank you very much.
You're welcome. Wait a moment while I print it.
003: I've lost my health card and I need a new one.
I'm sorry, for that you have to book an appointment at the health center.
Can't you help me here directly?
No, this procedure is handled at the health center in your area.
Understood, then I'll go there. What documents do I need?
Just your ID and a form they'll give you at the reception desk.
004: I want to renew my passport, what do I have to do?
First you have to book an appointment online or by phone.
I've already tried, but there are no appointments for a month.
I recommend you check every morning, because openings usually come up.
Okay, I'll try tomorrow early. How much does the renewal cost?
Thirty euros, and you pay at the bank before coming.
005: I need a criminal record certificate for a job.
You can request it right here if you bring your valid ID.
Yes, I have it here. How long does it take to arrive?
Normally it's sent by mail in about ten business days.
And is there no way to get it sooner?
If you're in a hurry, you can request it online and you'll receive it in two days.
006: Good morning, I've come to pick up my employment history report.
Did you request it online last week?
Yes, I requested it on Monday and they told me it would be ready today.
One moment, let me check it in the system.
Sure, I'm not in a hurry.
Here it is, everything is correct. Have a good day.
007: I want to change my address in the municipal registry.
Alright, can you tell me your new address, please?
Sun Street, number fifteen, third floor, right door.
Perfect, do you have any document that confirms it?
Yes, I have the signed rental contract.
Very well, in a few minutes I'll give you the updated certificate.
008: I need an appointment to renew my daughter's ID.
Is she a minor? Then you have to come with her.
Yes, she's twelve years old. What time do you recommend?
In the afternoon there are fewer people, around four o'clock.
Perfect, I'll book the appointment for Thursday at four.
Very well, don't forget to bring a recent photo.
009: I've received a fine and I want to know how to appeal it.
You have to submit a written appeal at this registry office.
And what is the deadline to do it?
You have twenty business days from the notification.
Okay, then I'll submit it this week. Do I need any form?
Yes, I'll give you the official form and help you fill it out.
010: I want to apply for housing rental assistance.
Very well, do you know if you meet the financial requirements?
I think so, but I'm not sure about the income limit.
I'll check it right now with your tax return.
Great, that clears up my doubts.
Indeed, you meet the requirements. Let me explain how to submit the application.
